resources.string: Import a door .gskill package. Commands and door bindings come only from the imported package.
Sign in to your door account. Credentials are encrypted with this device key store.
Select a door. Manual opening requires confirmation.
Clear the door account and password saved on this device?
Uninstalling also clears door credentials saved on this watch.
No document picker is available. Install a compatible file manager before importing .gskill.
Import failed: invalid package or integrity check. Existing configuration was not changed.
This local package configures commands, door names, and the default door. Exact opening commands send directly. Accounts stay on this watch. Integrity checks do not authenticate the publisher.
Could not save the Skill. Check device storage and retry.
The target is not unique. Select a door from the list.
Opening is unconfirmed and was not retried. Check the door in person.
Command sent. Check in person whether the door opened.
The door service rejected the command.
Sign-in failed. Check the network or update your credentials.
Door operation failed. Check the network and account, or try later.
List doors or locally open a uniquely matched door using an exact command.
Door service request failed; no opening command was sent. Check the network before retrying.
The target door is not unique; no command was sent. Name a door or request the door list.
The door service rejected the opening command.
Opening is unconfirmed and was not automatically retried. Check in person.
Door settings opened. Sign in once to enable automatic sign-in.
Local door list opened. No opening command was sent.
